titleEn: The Glory of Kings — God's Warning, the Fallen Angels and Noah's Ark (ch. 100, part 2 of 2)
part: ch. 100, part 2 of 2 — God's Warning, the Fallen Angels and Noah's Ark
about: God answers the boasting angels: transgressors will be held in chains until the great day, the faithful will sit at his right hand, and Satan can only suggest, never compel. The angels are then given flesh and descend to the daughters of Cain, whose offspring are giants (?), and God's wrath brings on the flood. Noah, who believes, is told to build an ark of wood, which the author reads as a figure of the Church and the Cross and ties to the Ark of the Covenant; the chapter closes with God's address, to Moses and through him to the people, calling them to sanctify themselves and seek the Ark.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ተመክሑ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ መፍቀሬ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ እምከመሰኬ ፡ ተስሕትክሙ ፡ በዐሊወ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ ግፍዕክሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ርእስክሙ ፡ ሐረረት ፡ ገህነም ፡ ወእሳት ፡ ወተይ ፡ ወመርቄ ፡ ወዐውሎ ፡ ምንባሪክሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ዐባይ ፡ ትትዐቀቡ ፡ በሰናስል ፡ ዘኢይትፈታሕ ፡ ወኢይሰበር ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: And-when thus they-boasted said-to-them God, lover-of man: since-indeed-then you-erred by-transgressing word-my, your-wrong upon head-your; heat-of Gehenna and-fire and-ተይ(?) and-መርቄ(?) and-whirlwind your-dwelling until day great; you-shall-be-kept in-chains which-not are-loosed and-not are-broken, until for-ever;
sentences.i: And when they had boasted in this way, God, the lover of mankind, said to them, “Since you have erred by transgressing my word, the wrong is on your own heads: the heat of Gehenna, and fire, and ተይ (?), and መርቄ (?), and whirlwind will be your dwelling until the great day. You will be kept in chains that are not loosed or broken, forever;
sentences.n: This is God's reply to the angels' boast at the end of ch. 100a (“we are spiritual … he is earthly”). ወሶበ is ወ- 'and' + ሶበ 'when'; ተመክሑ is the tä-stem perfect 3rd plural of መከሐ 'boast'; ይቤሎሙ 'he said to them' (ይቤ + ሎሙ). መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of man' is the construct (as in መፍቀሬ ምሕረት in ch. 100a), God's regular epithet here. እምከመሰኬ is እምከመ 'since, once' (so elsewhere in this book, with a perfect: 'since you have erred') strengthened by -ሰ and -ኬ, 'since indeed, then'. በዐሊወ is በ- + the infinitive of ዐለወ 'pass over, transgress' (the angels' own word in 100a, ኢንትዐደው … ኢነዐሉ). ግፍዕክሙ ላዕለ ርእስክሙ, literally 'your wrong upon your head', is the Semitic idiom that the guilt falls on the doer (compare Ezekiel 33:4) (?). The doom is a list of nouns forming the subject of ምንባሪክሙ 'your dwelling' (ምንባር + ክሙ; ምንባሪ- is the stem before suffixes, as in ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን, ch. 45, 62). I take ሐረረት as 'heat' and ዐውሎ as 'whirlwind'. ተይ and መርቄ I leave untranslated (?): ተይ recurs in ch. 101 as a cosmic element beside fire, wind and water (ላዕለ እሳት ወተይ), and መርቄ is left unplaced in the published parts (ch. 35, 78); the grammar gives no sense for either, and the first draft's 'smoke' and 'gloom' were guesses. ትትዐቀቡ is the passive tä-stem imperfect 'you will be kept (guarded)'; ዘኢይትፈታሕ 'which is not loosed' (relative ዘ + ኢ + tä-stem); እስከ ለዓለም 'forever'. The 'great day' is the day of judgment (Jude 6).

sentences.t: ወለእመሰ ፡ ጥዩቀ ፡ ዐቀብክሙ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ ወገበርክሙ ፡ ትእዛዝየ ፡ ትነብሩ ፡ በየማንየ ፡ ወበፀጋምየ ፤
sentences.l: and-if-indeed exactly you-kept word-my and-you-did commandment-my, you-shall-dwell at-right-hand-my and-at-left-hand-my;
sentences.i: but if you keep my word strictly and do my commandment, you will dwell at my right hand and at my left;
sentences.n: ወለእመሰ 'and if indeed' (ለእመ 'if' + -ሰ, contrasting with the doom above). ጥዩቀ 'exactly, strictly' is an accusative adverb (the same word as in the angels' plea 'test us strictly', 100a). ዐቀብክሙ and ገበርክሙ are 2nd plural perfects used for a future-sense condition ('if you have kept'); ትነብሩ 'you will dwell'. በየማንየ ወበፀጋምየ, 'at my right (hand) and at my left', is the place of honor and nearness (cf. Matthew 25:33–34; Mark 10:37).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘሞአ ፡ ኀየለ ፡ ወዘሰ ፡ ተመውአ ፡ ተኀየለ ፤
sentences.l: for all who overcame was-strong, and-he-who-indeed was-overcome was-overpowered(?);
sentences.i: for everyone who conquers prevails, and whoever is conquered is overpowered (?);
sentences.n: A maxim that grounds the choice just offered. ሞአ 'conquer, prevail' and its passive ተመውአ 'be conquered' (ተ- prefix, the passive/reflexive stem); ኀየለ 'be strong' and ተኀየለ 'be overpowered'. The verbs of conquest are key words of the speech and return in unit 4 (ሞኦ ለኅሊና 'overcame the thought') and unit 11 (ሞአ …, ተመውኡ 'were overcome'). ተኀየለ is read as the passive of ኀየለ, 'was overpowered', by its parallel with ተመውአ (?); the published entry gives 'prevailed, grew strong' for the same form, which the glosser should broaden.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ሰይጣንሂ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ዳእሙ ፡ ዘያሠርጽ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኅሊና ፡ ወኢይኤዝዝ ፡ ወኢያጌብር ፡ ወኢይዘብጥ ፡ ወኢይስሕብ ፡ ወኢይእኅዝ ፡ ወኢይትዋሣእ ፡ አላ ፡ በጽምሚት ፡ ያሠርጽ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኅሊና ፤
sentences.l: for Satan-also not-has power except only that-which he-sows into thought, and-not he-commands and-not he-compels and-not he-strikes and-not he-drags and-not he-seizes and-not he-disputes(?), but in-silence(?) he-sows into thought;
sentences.i: for Satan, too, has no power except only what he sows into the mind: he does not command, or compel, or strike, or drag, or seize, or dispute (?), but silently (?) he sows it into the mind;
sentences.n: እስመ ሰይጣንሂ 'for Satan too' (-ሂ 'also, even'). ዘእንበለ ዳእሙ 'except only'. ያሠርጽ is the causative (አ-stem) imperfect of ሠረጸ 'enter, spring up': 'he makes (a thought) enter, he plants'; ውስተ ኅሊና 'into the mind/thought'. The negated verbs ኢይኤዝዝ (አዘዘ 'command'), ኢያጌብር (አግበረ 'compel'; the long ጌ is unexpected, ያገብር being the regular form) (?), ኢይዘብጥ (ዘብጠ 'strike'), ኢይስሕብ (ሰሐበ 'drag'), ኢይእኅዝ (አኀዘ 'seize') are all imperfect 3rd masculine. ይትዋሣእ is the reciprocal (tä- with long ā) imperfect of the root of አውሥአ 'answer' (100a), hence 'answer back, dispute' (?); the first draft's 'take by force' had no support in the form. በጽምሚት 'in silence' (the published entry; also ch. 81, ቀበራሁ በጽምሚት) (?); 'secretly' is not given by the word. The teaching, that Satan only suggests and cannot compel, is the logic of the whole speech: the angels (and men) are responsible for yielding.

sentences.t: ወዘተሠጥዎ ፡ ለኅሊና ፡ እኩይ ፡ ይሬስዮ ፡ ለሀጒል ፡ ወእመሰ ፡ ሞኦ ፡ ለኅሊና ፡ እኩይ ፡ ረከበ ፡ ሞገሰ ፡ ወይከውኖ ፡ ምዝጋና ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: and-he-who yielded to-thought evil, it-makes-him for-destruction; and-if-indeed he-overcame thought evil, he-found favour and-it-will-be-to-him ምዝጋና(?) until for-ever;
sentences.i: and whoever yields to an evil thought, it brings him to destruction; but if he overcomes an evil thought, he finds favor, and it will be to him a glory (?) forever;
sentences.n: ዘተሠጥዎ is ዘ 'he who' + ተሠጥወ 'be persuaded, yield' (?; the verb is not attested elsewhere in the text, and its root, perhaps ሠጠወ 'draw, entice', is only a guess) + -ኦ 'it', literally 'who yielded to it', with ለኅሊና እኩይ 'to evil thought'. ይሬስዮ 'it makes him' (ረሰየ 'make, render' + -ዮ), ለሀጒል 'into destruction'. ሞኦ is the perfect of ሞአ + -ኦ ('overcame it'). ሞገሰ 'favor, grace'. ምዝጋና occurs nowhere else in the text; 'glory' (?) is a guess from the parallel with ሞገስ (flagged).

sentences.t: ወአንትሙኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ ፈቀድክሙ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ላዕሌክሙ ፡ ኅሊና ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወሥጋ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ ዑቁ ፡ ርእስክሙ ፡ ኢትትዐደዉ ፡ እምቃልየ ፡ ወኢትዕልዉ ፡ ትእዛዝየ ፡ ወኢታርኵሱ ፡ ርእስክሙ ፡ ኢበመብልዕ ፡ ወኢበመስቴ ፡ ወኢበዝሙት ፡ ወኢበዘኮነ ፡ ኢትዕድዉ ፡ እምቃልየ ፡ ወሶቤሃ ፡ ተውህቦሙ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ቃሉ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ወደም ፡ ወልበ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ ወተሠርሙ ፡ እመልዕልተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወወረዲ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እበደ ፡ ዘፍኖሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ቀየን ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኪኖሙ ፡ ዘተኬነዉ ፡ በእበደ ፡ ዝሙቶሙ ፡ ወማሕሌቶሙ ፡ በከበሮ ፡ ወበመሰንቆ ፡ ወበዕንዚራ ፡ ወበረዓም ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ይባቤ ፡ ወማሕሌት ፤
sentences.l: and-you-also as you-wished let-be upon-you thought-of man and-flesh-of man; but guard head-your, not you-transgress from-word-my and-not you-overstep commandment-my and-not you-defile head-your not by-food and-not by-drink and-not by-fornication and-not by-whatever it-was: not you-pass-beyond from-word-my.” And-then was-given-to-them with word-his flesh and-blood and-heart-of offspring-of mother-of-the-living, and-they-were-sent(?) from-height-of heaven, and-they-descended(?) earth, to madness-of dance(?)-their of-sons-of Qayen, with all art-their which-they-practised(?) in-madness-of fornication-their and-song-their with-drum and-with-lyre and-with-harp and-with-noise much with shouting and-song;
sentences.i: And as for you, as you have wished, let the mind of man and the flesh of man be upon you. But guard yourselves: do not transgress my word, or overstep my commandment, or defile yourselves, whether by food, or by drink, or by fornication, or by anything at all; do not pass beyond my word.” And then there were given to them, along with his word, flesh and blood and the heart of a human being, and they were sent forth (?) from the heights of heaven and came down (?) to earth, to the madness of the dancing (?) of the sons of Cain, with all their craft in which they busied themselves (?) in the madness of their fornication and singing, with drum and lyre and harp and much noise, with shouting and song;
sentences.n: The longest unit (58 words) and it has no ፤ at which to cut it, so I keep it whole as printed. It carries a turn: God's speech ends at ኢትዕድዉ እምቃልየ and the narrative of the angels' fall begins at ወሶቤሃ, so I close the quotation inside the unit. ወአንትሙኒ 'and you too'; በከመ ፈቀድክሙ ይኩን 'as you have wished, let it be' (jussive ይኩን 'let it be'): the sense is that they are given what they have chosen, a man's thought and flesh (?). ዑቁ is taken as the imperative plural of ዐቀበ 'keep, guard' (an irregular form, the plain imperative being ዕቀቡ; it occurs only here) (?) (ርእስክሙ 'yourselves', lit. 'your heads'); the prohibitions are ኢ- + 2nd plural imperfect, with the object ርእስክሙ after ኢታርኵሱ (አርኰሰ 'defile'); ኢበ- means 'not by'. ኢትዕድዉ is a form of ዐደወ 'pass over', as ኢትትዐደዉ at the start of the sentence. ተውህቦሙ 'was given to them' (ተወሀበ + ሙ); ልበ እጓለ እመሕያው 'heart of a human' (እመሕያው is እም 'mother' + ሕያው 'living', as in the published entry, so the phrase is lit. 'offspring of the mother of the living', the Geʿez idiom for a human being). This is the story of Genesis 6:1–4 (the sons of God and the daughters of men), told here with the daughters of Cain's line. Readings I am unsure of: ተሠርሙ, which I take as 'were sent forth/cast out' (?) (its ending -ሙ is the pronoun 'them', as in ተውህቦሙ, not the plural ending of the perfect, so it may be an impersonal passive; it occurs nowhere else), and ወረዲ (?), which I take as a variant of ወረዱ 'they descended' (the same form, ወረዲ ውስተ ሲኦል ሕያዋኒሆሙ, stands in ch. 97 beside a plural subject) (the 3rd-order vowel is not the usual plural ending); ዘፍኖሙ from ዘፈነ 'sing, dance' (?) (cf. ይዘፍኑ ወይትዋነዩ, ch. 6) and እበደ as 'madness' (cf. ለእበድ in 100a); ኪኖሙ from ኪን 'art, craft' with ዘተኬነዉ 'which they practised' (?), the same verb as ተኬነወ in 100a unit 9 and unit 11 below, where the sense 'was zealous' is read (?); the glossary entry must cover all three. ኪን 'craft, skill' also occurs in በኪን ዘወሀቦ እግዚኣብሔር (ch. 25), so ተኬነወ may rather be 'worked skilfully, took pains' than 'was zealous' (?). Instruments: ከበሮ (drum), መሰንቆ (lyre), ዕንዚራ (harp), ረዓም (noise, thunder); ይባቤ 'shouting' (?) (cf. በውውዓ በትፍሥሕት ወበይባቤ among the instruments and acclamations of ch. 39).

sentences.t: ወአዋልዲሆሙኒ ፡ ህየ ፡ ሀለዋ ፡ ወይትዋነያ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ኀፍረት ፡ እስመ ፡ ተምዕዛ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ወአደማሆሙ ፡ ወሆካ ፡ ኅሊናሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: and-daughters-their-also there were-present and-they-made-merry without shame, for they-were-pleasing to-them and-pleased-them(?) and-agitated mind-their;
sentences.i: and their daughters, too, were there and made merry without shame, for they were pleasing to them, and delighted them (?), and troubled their minds;
sentences.n: The women are the daughters of Cain's line named in unit 5. ወአዋልዲሆሙኒ 'and their daughters too'; ሀለዋ 'they (f.) were present'; ይትዋነያ 'they make merry' (tä-stem imperfect, 3rd feminine plural). ዘእንበለ ኀፍረት 'without shame'. The three verbs are 3rd feminine plural perfects with the women as subject, like ሀለዋ: ተምዕዛ, አደማሆሙ (አደመ + -ኣ + ሆሙ 'them') and ሆካ, so ሆካ ኅሊናሆሙ is 'they disturbed their minds' (ኅሊናሆሙ the object; ሆከ 'disturb'). ተምዕዛ ሎሙ 'they were pleasing to them' is the tä-stem of መዐዘ 'be fragrant, sweet', as in ተሠነየት ወተምዕዘት ሎቱ 'she became fair and pleasing to him' (ch. 64). አደማሆሙ is አደመ 'please, be agreeable to' (አደመኒ አውሥኦትከ 'your answer pleased me', ch. 26; ኢይኤድሞ ለልብየ 'does not please my heart', ch. 36) + the feminine plural ending + ሆሙ 'them', so 'they pleased them' (?); the first draft's 'made them bloody' (from ደም) is dropped. The two verbs say that the women delighted the men, and ሆካ then says what that did to their minds.

sentences.t: ወኢተዐገሱ ፡ አሐተ ፡ ሰዐተ ፡ አላ ፡ ነሥኡ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ለርእሶሙ ፡ እምኔሆን ፡ ዘዘ ፡ ኀረዩ ፡ አንስትያ ፡ ወአበሱ ፡ ምስሌሆን ፤
sentences.l: and-not they-endured one hour, but they-took for-them for-selves from-them each-who they-chose, women, and-they-sinned with-them;
sentences.i: and they did not hold out for a single hour, but took for themselves from among them women, each one whom they had chosen, and they sinned with them;
sentences.n: ወኢተዐገሱ 'and they did not endure' (ተዐገሰ 'endure, be patient'). ነሥኡ ሎሙ ለርእሶሙ 'they took for themselves' (the dative ሎሙ and ለርእሶሙ both stress the reflexive). እምኔሆን 'from them (f.)'. The printed ዘዘ ኀረዩ: ዘዘ is the distributive 'each, every' (ዘዘ ዓመት 'each year', ch. 47; the published entry), so 'each one whom they chose', with አንስትያ 'women' in apposition. ኀረዩ 'they chose'; ወአበሱ 'they sinned' (አበሰ), ምስሌሆን 'with them (f.)'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኢያዐርፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልበ ፡ ዕቡያን ፡ ወሐማይያን ፡ አላ ፡ ያዐርፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልበ ፡ ትሑታን ፡ ወየዋሃን ፡ ወበወንጌልሂ ፡ ነገረ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ አሌሎሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ያጸድቁ ፡ ርእሶሙ ፡ ወይሜንኑ ፡ ቢጾሙ ፤
sentences.l: for God not-rests in heart-of the-proud and-slanderers, but rests in heart-of humble-ones and-simple-ones; and-in-gospel-also he-spoke while he-says: woe-to-them to-those-who justify themselves and-despise neighbours-their;
sentences.i: For God does not rest in the heart of the proud and the slanderers, but rests in the heart of the humble and the simple; and in the Gospel, too, he spoke, saying, “Woe to those who justify themselves and despise their neighbors”;
sentences.n: A general principle supports the verdict on the angels who 'slandered' Adam (ሐመየ, 100a): the slanderers (ሐማይያን, plural of the agent noun ሐማይ) are lumped with the proud (ዕቡያን). ያዐርፍ 'rests' (አዐረፈ), the causative-stem verb used with God as subject; ትሑታን 'humble ones', የዋሃን 'simple, guileless ones' (plural adjectives). ወበወንጌልሂ 'and in the Gospel too': the reference is to the Gospel's teaching on self-justifying pride, Luke 18:9–14 (the Pharisee and the tax collector) and Luke 16:15, and 'woe' (አሌሎሙ) in the Gospels (e.g. Luke 6:24–26); the wording is the author's own. ያጸድቁ ርእሶሙ 'they justify themselves' (lit. 'their heads'); ይሜንኑ 'they despise' (መነነ); ቢጾሙ 'their companions, neighbors'.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ይቤ ፡ እስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ያፈቅሮሙ ፡ ለትሑታን ፡ ወያኀስሮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ያዐብዩ ፡ ርእሶሙ ፡ ወሶቤሃ ፡ ተምዕዖሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአሰሮሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ረዓደ ፡ ሲኦል ፡ እስከ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ፍዳ ፤
sentences.l: and-again he-said: for God loves-them the-humble and-causes-them-loss those-who magnify heads-their; and-then God-was-angry-with-them and-bound-them in dread(?)-of Sheol until day-of recompense;
sentences.i: And again he said, “God loves the humble, and diminishes those who make themselves great.” And then God was angry with them and bound them in the terror (?) of Sheol until the day of recompense,
sentences.n: The second saying echoes the Gospel teaching that those who exalt themselves will be humbled (Luke 14:11, 18:14; Matthew 23:12). ያፈቅሮሙ 'he loves them', ያኀስሮሙ 'he causes them loss, diminishes them' (causative of ኀሰረ 'lack'; 'brings low' would be Luke's wording, not the form's), ያዐብዩ 'they magnify' (ዐበየ). ወሶቤሃ ተምዕዖሙ 'and then he was angry with them' returns to the angels (same verb as in 100a). አሰሮሙ 'he bound them' (አሰረ 'bind'). ረዓደ ሲኦል, construct, 'the dread/trembling of Sheol' (?) (the same phrase of Satan in ch. 99; published ረዓድ 'dread, trembling, terror (?)'), ሲኦል 'Sheol'. ዕለተ ፍዳ 'day of recompense' is the day of judgment; the same event as the 'great day' of unit 0.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ሐዋርያ ፡ ለመላእክቲሁ ፡ አቢሶሙ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ኢመሐኮሙ ፡ አላ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደይን ፡ አንበሮሙ ፡ ወተአስሩ ፡ ለዕለት ፡ ዐባይ ፤
sentences.l: as he-said apostle about-angels-his: their-sinning exceedingly(?) not he-spared-them but into judgment he-placed-them, and-they-were-bound for-day great;
sentences.i: as the Apostle said about his angels: “In their great sinning (?) he did not spare them, but set them in judgment, and they were bound for the great day”;
sentences.n: A citation of an apostle (singular ሐዋርያ, the Apostle). It rests on 2 Peter 2:4 ('God spared not the angels that sinned … reserved unto judgment') and Jude 6 (angels 'kept in everlasting chains … unto the judgment of the great day'); I name both because the Geʿez does not say which, and the words are the author's own. ኢመሐኮሙ 'he did not spare them' (መሐከ + -ሙ; the verb is found nowhere else in the book, and the printed ኮ may stand for ሮ, መሐረ 'have mercy, spare') (?); አንበሮሙ 'he set them' (አንበረ); ወተአስሩ 'and they were bound' (passive tä-stem of አሰረ). አቢሶሙ is the infinitive of አበሰ 'sin' (አቢሶ, the same pattern as ዐቂበ, ክሒደ, ዐሊወ in 100a) + -ሙ 'their', 'their sinning', with ጥቀ 'exceedingly'; I take the clause as causal, 'in their great sinning he did not spare them' (?). I mark the Apostle's words as a quotation.

sentences.t: ሞአ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዘተኬነወ ፡ በልሕኵቱ ፡ አዳም ፡ ወተመውኡ ፡ እለ ፡ ሐመይዎ ፡ ወተሳለቁ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ ወእለሰ ፡ ተስሕቱ ፡ ቦቶን ፡ መላእክት ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ቀየን ፡ ፀንሳ ፡ ወስእና ፡ ወሊደ ፡ ወሞታ ፡ ወእለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከርሦንሂ ፡ ቦእለ ፡ ሞቱ ፡ ወቦእለ ፡ ወፅኡ ፡ ሠጢቆሙ ፡ ከርሠ ፡ እሞሙ ፡ ወፅኡ ፡ እንተ ፡ ሕንብርቲሆን ፤
sentences.l: overcame(?) word-of God which was-zealous(?) for-moulded-work-his Adam, and-were-overcome those-who slandered-him and-mocked upon-him upon-Adam; and-those-indeed who-erred through-them(f.), the-angels: daughters-of Qayen conceived and-were-unable to-bear and-died, and-those in womb-their-also, some died and-some came-out, their-splitting womb-of mother-their and-came-out by(?) navel-their;
sentences.i: The word of God prevailed (?), the word that was zealous (?) for his moulded creature Adam, and those who had slandered him and mocked him, Adam, were overcome. But as for those who had gone astray through the women, the angels: the daughters of Cain conceived and, unable to bear, died; and of those in their wombs, some died and some came out, splitting the womb of their mother, and came out by their navels;
sentences.n: ሞአ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር: ቃለ has the accusative/construct ending, so strictly the verb has no stated subject and 'the word of God' is its object ('[he] overcame the word of God'). I keep 'the word of God prevailed' because the next clause has the slanderers 'overcome' (ተመውኡ, echoing the rule of unit 2), but the case ending is against it (?). ዘተኬነወ በልሕኵቱ አዳም: ልሕኵት is a 'moulded thing, creature' (ለሐከ; ልሕኵትየ in 100a unit 9, ልሕኵቱ in ch. 60, ቀዳሜ ልሕኵቱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the first of God's moulded things' of Adam in ch. 64), not 'weakness'; so 'zealous for his moulded creature, Adam', with ተኬነወ as in 100a unit 9 (እስመ ተኬነወ እግዚኣብሔር በእንተ አዳም) (?). እለ ሐመይዎ 'those who slandered him' (ሐመየ + -ዎ; same word as ዘሐመይዎ in 100a), ተሳለቁ 'mocked' (ተሳለቀ). እለሰ ተስሕቱ ቦቶን 'those who erred through them (f.)': ቦቶን anticipates አዋልደ ቀየን, and መላእክት is the antecedent in apposition; the daughters of Cain are the subject of ፀንሳ. The grammar of the women is feminine plural throughout: ፀንሳ 'they conceived', ስእና ወሊደ 'unable to bear' (ስእነ 'be unable' + infinitive), ሞታ 'they died'. ቦእለ is ቦ 'there are' + እለ 'those who' ('some who'). ሠጢቆሙ is the infinitive of ሠጠቀ 'split' (cf. ባሕረ ኤርትራ እንተ ተሠጥቀት, ch. 55) + -ሙ 'their', 'their splitting the womb of their mother'; ወፅኡ እንተ ሕንብርቲሆን 'came out by their navels' (እንተ read as 'by way of', otherwise the relative 'which') (?); ሕንብርቲሆን 'their navels'. The offspring are the giants of the next unit (compare Genesis 6:4).

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ልህቁ ፡ ወተሐፅኑ ፡ ኮኑ ፡ ረዐይተ ፡ እለ ፡ ኑኆሙ ፡ ይበጽሕ ፡ እስከ ፡ ደመናት ፡ ዘበእንቲአሆሙ ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ አነኀ ፡ መዐቶ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ኢይንበር ፡ መንፈስየ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ፻ወ፳ ፡ ዓመት ፤
sentences.l: and-when they-grew and-were-nursed became ረዐይተ(?) those-who height-their reaches until clouds; on-account-of-them and-on-account-of sinners prolonged(?) his-wrath upon-them God, and-said: not let-dwell spirit-my upon-them except 120 years;
sentences.i: And when they grew and were reared, they became giants (?) whose height reached to the clouds. Because of them and of the sinners, God prolonged (?) his wrath against them, and said, “My spirit shall not remain upon them except for 120 years”;
sentences.n: ተሐፅኑ 'they were reared' (passive of ሐፀነ 'nurse'); ኮኑ ረዐይተ 'they became …'. ረዐይተ I translate as 'giants' (?) because of the relative clause 'whose height reaches to the clouds' (ኑኆሙ 'their height', ይበጽሕ 'reaches'); the form looks like a plural of ረዓይ 'shepherd', which would not make sense here, so this is from context only; elsewhere ረዐይ- is 'tend, shepherd' (ch. 98 ሥልሰ ረዐይኬ አባግዕየ) (?). ዘበእንቲአሆሙ 'on account of them'; አነኀ መዐቶ 'he prolonged his wrath' (causative of the root of ነዋኅ 'long' and ከመ ይኑኅ መዋዕሊክሙ 'that your days be long', ch. 90; ኑኆሙ 'their length, height' is the same root) (?). The quoted word recalls Genesis 6:3; ዘእንበለ ፻ወ፳ ዓመት is built from the Geʿez as 'except for 120 years'. The number ፻ወ፳ (printed as numerals) is 'hundred and twenty'.

sentences.t: ወአኅለቆሙ ፡ በማየ ፡ አይኅ ፡ ሎሙኒ ፡ ወለኵሎሙ ፡ ኃጥ ፡ ኣን ፡ እለ ፡ አልቦሙ ፡ አሚነ ፡ በቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: and-he-destroyed-them with-water-of flood, them-also and-all the-sinners who not-have faith in-word-of God;
sentences.i: and he destroyed them with the waters of the flood, both them and all the sinners who had no faith in the word of God;
sentences.n: ወአኅለቆሙ 'and he destroyed them' (አኅለቀ). ማየ አይኅ 'water of the flood' (construct); ሎሙኒ ወለኵሎሙ 'both them and all', the -ኒ 'also' linking the giants and the sinners. The printed ኃጥ ኣን is a split of ኃጥኣን 'sinners' (plural of ኃጥእ), kept as printed. እለ አልቦሙ አሚነ 'who have no faith' (አልቦሙ 'they have not', አሚነ 'faith' as an accusative). Genesis 6–7.

sentences.t: ወእለሰ ፡ አምኑ ፡ በቃለ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ወገብሩ ፡ ፈቃዶ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘረከቦሙ ፡ እኩይ ፡ እምውእቱ ፡ አይኅ ፡ አላ ፡ አድኀኖሙ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ለእመ ፡ አመንከ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ ትክል ፡ ድኂነ ፡ እምአይኅ ፤
sentences.l: and-those-indeed believed in-word-of fathers-their and-did will-his: not-there-was that-which-befell-them evil from-that flood, but saved-them while he-says: if you-believe word-my you-will-be-able to-be-saved from-flood;
sentences.i: But those who believed the word of their fathers and did his will nothing evil from that flood befell them, but he saved them, saying, “If you believe my word, you will be able to be saved from the flood”;
sentences.n: The faithful ('those who believed') are Noah's family. አምኑ 'they believed', ገብሩ 'they did' (3rd plural perfects). አልቦ ዘረከቦሙ እኩይ 'there was nothing that found them, evil' (ረከበ 'find, befall'). The saying turns to the singular (አመንከ 'you believe', ትክል 'you will be able'), addressed to Noah, and the next units then give his answer. ለእመ 'if' + a perfect gives a conditional; ድኂነ is the infinitive of ድኅነ 'be saved'.

sentences.t: ወይቤ ፡ ኖሕ ፡ አመንኩ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ወአይድዐኒ ፡ በዘ ፡ እድኅን ፤
sentences.l: and-said Noah: I-believed, my-Lord, word-yours, and-tell-me by-what I-shall-be-saved;
sentences.i: And Noah said, “I believed, O Lord, your word; and tell me by what I shall be saved.”
sentences.n: ኖሕ is Noah. እግዚኦ is the vocative 'O Lord' (as in 100a). አመንኩ 'I believed' (1st singular perfect); አይድዐኒ is the imperative of አይድዐ ('make known, tell'; cf. አይድዕኒ, ch. 32) + -ኒ 'me'; በዘ እድኅን 'by what I shall be saved' (በ + ዘ 'that by which', subjunctive 1st singular). The conversation follows Genesis 6:13–16 but is the author's own telling.

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ በዕፅ ፡ ትድኅን ፡ እማይ ፤
sentences.l: and-said-to-him: by-wood you-shall-be-saved from-water;
sentences.i: And he said to him, “By wood you will be saved from the water.”
sentences.n: God answers in few words, with the key word ዕፅ 'wood/tree' that the author will use to join the ark to the Cross (units 21–22). ትድኅን 'you will be saved' (imperfect); እማይ 'from water' (እም- 'from' + ማይ).

sentences.t: ወይቤ ፡ እፎ ፡ እግዚእየ ፤
sentences.l: and-said: how, my-lord;
sentences.i: And he said, “How, my lord?”
sentences.n: እፎ 'how'; እግዚእየ 'my lord' (እግዚእ + የ 'my'), in contrast to the vocative እግዚኦ in the previous speech.

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ ግበር ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ርብዕት ፡ ወጽርባ ፡ ወግበር ፡ ላቲ ፡ ፫ ፡ ውሣጥያተ ፡ ወባእ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ቤትከ ፤
sentences.l: and-said-to-him: make ark square and-ጽርባ(?) and-make for-her 3 compartments and-enter inside-her with all household-your;
sentences.i: And he said to him, “Make an ark, square and ጽርባ (?), and make for it three compartments, and enter into it with all your household.”
sentences.n: Compare Genesis 6:14–18. ታቦት 'ark' (the word for Noah's ark is the same as for the Ark of the Covenant, so the author builds on the name); ታቦተ is the accusative. ርብዕት 'square, four-sided' (feminine adjective). The next word ጽርባ is unclear to me: possibly a noun 'pitch' or a participle 'smeared, sealed' (Genesis 6:14 has the ark covered with pitch) (?), and I keep it untranslated in the text. ላቲ 'for her' (the ark is feminine); ፫ is the numeral 'three' (ሠለስት); ውሣጥያተ 'inner rooms' (plural of ውሣጢ); ባእ 'enter' (imperative singular of ቦአ).

sentences.t: ወአምነ ፡ በቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወገብረ ፡ ወድኅነ ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ዝ ፡ ስምዑኒ ፡ እፈክር ፡ ለክሙ ፤
sentences.l: and-he-believed in-word-of God and-did and-was-saved; and-concerning this hear-me I-shall-explain to-you;
sentences.i: And he believed the word of God, and did it, and was saved; and concerning this, hear me: I will explain it to you.
sentences.n: Noah's story now becomes a teaching in the author's own voice (the speaker addresses his hearers, ለክሙ 'to you' plural). አምነ 'he believed', ገብረ 'he did', ድኅነ 'he was saved'. ስምዑኒ is the imperative plural of ሰምዐ 'hear' + -ኒ 'me' (the published entry: 'hear me!'); እፈክር 'I will explain' (ፈከረ).

sentences.t: ሶበ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ እምወህቦ ፡ ክንፈ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንስር ፡ ወእምአዕደዎ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ሕያዋን ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ እስከ ፡ ያቈርር ፡ መዐተ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ እለ ፡ ኢየአምኑ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወቃለ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ አው ፡ እምአዕረጎ ፡ እስከ ፡ አየር ፡ አው ፡ እምአዘዞ ፡ ለማየ ፡ አይኅ ፡ ከመ ፡ አረፍት ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይቅረባ ፡ ለአሐቲ ፡ ደብር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ያነብሮ ፡ ለኖሕ ፡ ወለደቂቁ ፡ ወለእለ ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ አራዊተ ፡ ወእንስሳ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይድፍኖሙ ፤
sentences.l: when commanded God, instead-of giving-him wing like eagle and instead-of bringing-him-across(?) land-of the-living with all house-his until he-should-cool wrath upon sinners who not-believe word-of God and-word-of fathers-their, or instead-of raising-him to air, or instead-of commanding the-water-of flood like wall that-not they-approach one mountain where he-would-set Noah and-sons-his and-those-whom he-willed, beasts and-livestock, that-not it-bury-them;
sentences.i: When God gave the command, rather than giving him a wing like an eagle's, and carrying him across to the land of the living with all his house until he should cool his wrath against the sinners who do not believe the word of God and the word of their fathers; or rather than lifting him up into the air; or rather than commanding the waters of the flood to be like a wall, so that they would not come near one mountain where he would set Noah and his sons and those he wished, beasts and livestock, so that they would not bury them —
sentences.n: This unit (about 49 words, with no ፤ at which to cut it) is one long subordinate sentence whose main clause is the next unit. Its pattern is ሶበ አዘዘ 'when he commanded', then four times እም- + perfect + ኦ 'rather than his having …' (እምወህቦ, እምአዕደዎ, እምአዕረጎ, እምአዘዞ): 'rather than giving him … rather than bringing him across …'; ወህቦ is the perfect ወሀበ + ኦ with እም- ('than that he gave him'). ክንፈ ከመ ንስር, 'a wing like an eagle', recalls Exodus 19:4 ('I bore you on eagles' wings'); ብሔረ ሕያዋን 'land of the living' (Psalm 27:13, 52:5); ያቈርር 'he cools' (the causative አቈረረ of ቈረረ 'be cold', not the simple stem; the published entry; cf. ያቈርር መዐቶ, ch. 62). አዕደዎ 'he brought him across' (አዕደወ) and አው 'or'. ከመ አረፍት: አረፍት is a noun, 'wall' (the published entry; ቆመ ማይ ከመ አረፍት 'the water stood like a wall', ch. 17; አረፍት በይምን ወአረፍት በፅግም 'a wall on the right and a wall on the left', ch. 55), so 'that the water of the flood be like a wall', as at the Jordan and the Red Sea; the first draft's verb reading is dropped; ከመ ኢይቅረባ 'that they (f.) not approach' and ከመ ኢይድፍኖሙ 'that it not bury them' (ደፈነ 'cover, bury'); ለአሐቲ ደብር 'one mountain'. The sense is: why did God not use some wonderful means? (Genesis 6–8.)

sentences.t: ወባሕቱ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ አእምሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠምረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ በዕፅ ፡ ዘተቀደሰ ፡ ኮነ ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ ፍጥረቱ ፡ እሉ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ወዕፀ ፡ መስቀል ፤
sentences.l: but this know: that was-pleased God in-wood which-was-sanctified, became salvation-of creation-his: these, the-ark and-wood-of cross;
sentences.i: but know this: God was pleased with wood that had been made holy, and it became the salvation of his creation: these are the ark and the wood of the Cross.
sentences.n: The main clause that answers unit 20: he chose wood, for the wood was sacred. ባሕቱ 'but', አእምሩ 'know' (imperative plural), ሠምረ 'was pleased (with, በ-)', ዘተቀደሰ 'which was sanctified' (passive tä-stem of ቀደሰ); መድኀኒተ is the accusative of መድኀኒት 'salvation' (or 'saviour'); ፍጥረቱ 'his creation'. This is the centre of the author's argument: the wooden ark (Noah's) and the wood of the Cross are the two vessels of salvation. ዕፀ መስቀል 'wood of the cross', in the construct.

sentences.t: ይቤሎ ፡ ግበር ፡ በዘ ፡ ትድኅን ፡ ዛቲኬ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ዘቤተ ፡ ክርስቲያን ፡ ወሶበኒ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ ግበር ፡ ርብዕተ ፡ ያርኢ ፡ ዝኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ በርባዔ ፡ ትእምርተ ፡ መስቀል ፤
sentences.l: he-said-to-him: make by-which you-shall-be-saved: this-then ark of-house-of Christians; and-when-also he-said-to-him: make square, shows this-also that by-four sign-of cross;
sentences.i: He said to him, “Make that by which you will be saved”: this, then, is the ark of the Church. And when he said to him, “Make it square,” this too shows, by its fourfold shape (?), the sign of the Cross.
sentences.n: ዛቲኬ ታቦት ዘቤተ ክርስቲያን, 'this, then, is the ark of the Church' (ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'house of Christians', the regular word for 'church'): Noah's ark is read as a figure (type) of the Church, the vessel of salvation. ወሶበኒ 'and when also'; ርብዕተ 'square' (accusative); ያርኢ is the causative (አ-stem) of ርእየ 'see', 'he shows'. ከመ በርባዔ ትእምርተ መስቀል: the number 'four' (ርባዔ) gives the sign (ትእምርት) of the Cross, since the cross has four arms (?); the grammar of ከመ here is not smooth, and I translate by the sense.

sentences.t: ፬ ፡ መኣዝኒሃ ፡ ለታቦት ፡ ዝውእቱ ፡ አቅርንተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፤
sentences.l: 4 corners-its of-the-ark, this-is horns-of altar;
sentences.i: The four corners of the ark are the horns of the altar;
sentences.n: The numeral ፬ is 'four' (አርባዕቱ, spoken). መኣዝኒሃ 'its corners' (plural of መኣዝን + ሃ 'her'), ዝውእቱ 'this is'. The altar's four horns are described in Exodus 27:2 and 30:2, so the ark of the church is likened to the altar.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ታቦተ ፡ እምዕፅ ፡ ዘኢይነቅዝ ፤
sentences.l: as he-commanded Moses: let-him-make ark of-wood which-not rots;
sentences.i: as he commanded Moses to make an ark of wood that does not rot.
sentences.n: Now the Ark of the Covenant: Exodus 25:10 (acacia wood). ይግበር 'let him make' is the jussive in reported command ('that he make'), with ለሙሴ 'to Moses'; ዘኢይነቅዝ 'which does not rot' (ነቀዘ 'be worm-eaten, rot'). The same phrase 'wood that does not rot' appears in the preceding chapters of this book.

sentences.t: ወአነ ፡ እቄድሶ ፡ ለከ ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እዴየ ፡ ሰማያዊት ፡ መንፈሳዊት ፡ ወአንተኒ ፡ ቀድስ ፡ ርእሰከ ፡ እምግምንና ፡ ወርኵስ ፡ ወዝሙት ፡ ወቂም ፡ ወሐሰት ፡ ምስለ ፡ እኁከ ፡ ወቤትከ ፡ ወንጹሕ ፡ በንጹሕ ፡ ሡዕ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወአነ ፡ እትዌከፍ ፡ ለከ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ቀደስከ ፡ ርእሰከ ፡ ወቤትከ ፡ አዝዞሙ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ይቀድሱ ፡ ርእሶሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቅድሳትየ ፡ በቅዱሳን ፤
sentences.l: and-I I-shall-sanctify-it for-you in-her(?), work-of hands-my, heavenly spiritual; and-you-also sanctify head-your from abomination(?) and-uncleanness and-fornication and-grudge and-falsehood with brother-your, and-house-your, pure with-pure sacrifice to-me; and-I I-shall-receive for-you after you-sanctified head-your and-house-your; command them all the-people let-them-sanctify heads-their, for holy-things-my with-holy-ones;
sentences.i: “And I will sanctify it for you, in her (?), the work of my hands, heavenly and spiritual. And you also, sanctify yourself from abomination (?), and uncleanness, and fornication, and grudge, and falsehood, together with your brother and your house; and, pure with pure (?), sacrifice to me; and I will receive it from you (?) after you have sanctified yourself and your house. Command all the people to sanctify themselves, for my holy things are with the holy ones;
sentences.n: God speaks in the first person from here to the end of the part. The singular 'you' is Moses: unit 24 has God commanding Moses (ለሙሴ … ይግበር), the speech slips from that reported command into direct address, ምስለ እኁከ 'with your brother' fits Aaron, and አዝዞሙ ለኵሉ ሕዝብ 'command all the people' is the formula of ch. 90 (ወይቤሎ ለሙሴ አዝዞሙ) and the published entry reads it as 'addressed to Moses'; from ወለእመ መጻእክሙ the plural 'you' is the people. Noah, the 'you' of units 14–19, is not addressed here (?). በይእቲ 'in her' presumably the ark, which is feminine; እቄድሶ 'I will sanctify him/it' is masculine, so the object is perhaps the wood (?). ሰማያዊት መንፈሳዊት 'heavenly, spiritual' as in the preceding chapters, where the true ark in heaven is the model of the earthly one (cf. Hebrews 8:5, Exodus 25:40). ቀድስ ርእሰከ 'sanctify yourself' (imperative; ርእሰከ 'your head' = 'yourself'); the list ግምንና (?; unattested elsewhere) ወርኵስ ወዝሙት ወቂም ወሐሰት 'abomination, uncleanness, fornication, grudge, falsehood' are all objects of the preposition እም-. ወንጹሕ በንጹሕ ሡዕ ሊተ: ሡዕ is the 2nd singular imperative of ሠውዐ 'sacrifice' (ሡዕ ሊተ ወልድከ, ch. 12; ይሡዕ ሊተ, ch. 46; the published entry), not a noun; ወንጹሕ በንጹሕ 'pure with pure' I take as what is pure, by what is pure, i.e. clean gifts from clean persons (?). ወአነ እትዌከፍ ለከ 'and I will receive from you' (እትዌከፍ, from ተወከፈ); ቅድሳትየ በቅዱሳን 'my holy things (are) with the holy', cf. Leviticus 19:2, 1 Peter 1:16.

sentences.t: ዘንተኬ ፡ ተኀሥሥ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ኪዳንየ ፡ እንተ ፡ ፈጠርክዋ ፡ ለስብሐትየ ፡ ወለእመ ፡ መጻእክሙ ፡ በንጹሕ ፡ ልብ ፡ በፍቅር ፡ ወበሰላም ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ተቃጽቦ ፡ ወተሓምዮ ፡ ወአርታዕክሙ ፡ ልብክሙ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወለቢጽክሙ ፡ እሰምዐክሙ ፡ ጸሎተክሙ ፡ ወኣፀምእ ፡ ስእለትክሙ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ዘተጋነይክሙ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወእመጽእ ፡ ወእሄሉ ፡ ምስሌክሙ ፡ ወኣንሶሱ ፡ ማእከሌክሙ ፡ ወአኀ ፡ ድር ፡ ውስተ ፡ አልባቢክሙ ፤
sentences.l: this-then seek, ark-of covenant-my which I-created for-glory-my; and-if you-came with-pure heart, in-love and-in-peace, without mutual-striking(?) and-mutual-slander and-you-set-right heart-your to-me and-to-neighbour-your, I-shall-hear you your-prayer and-I-shall-incline-ear(?) supplication-your in all which you-supplicated(?) to-me; and-I-shall-come and-I-shall-be with-you and-I-shall-walk-about among-you and-I-shall-dwell in hearts-your;
sentences.i: seek this, then: the ark of my covenant, which I created for my glory. And if you come with a pure heart, in love and in peace, without quarrelling (?) or slandering one another, and set your hearts right toward me and toward your neighbor, I will hear your prayer, and I will give ear (?) to your petition in all that you have entreated of me (?). And I will come and be with you, and I will walk among you, and I will dwell in your hearts;
sentences.n: The printed ኣፀምእ is the first-person imperfect ኣጽምእ, 'I will give ear' (from አጽምአ), with the ኣ initial (?); the usual verb for 'give ear' is spelled with ዐ (አጽምዐ), so the -እ may be a spelling variant (?). ዘንተኬ 'this, then' (ዘንተ + -ኬ). ተኀሥሥ is 2nd singular (not plural; the published entry parses it as the imperfect 'you search'), and I translate it as an imperative 'seek' (?). ታቦተ ኪዳንየ 'ark of my covenant', in the construct, and እንተ ፈጠርክዋ 'which I created her' (relative እንተ + ፈጠርኩ + ዋ 'her'). ወለእመ መጻእክሙ 'and if you come' (ለእመ + perfect). ተቃጽቦ and ተሓምዮ are tä-stem reciprocal verbal nouns ('one another'): ተሓምዮ 'slandering one another' (from ሐመየ, the word of the angels in 100a), ተቃጽቦ 'striking one another' (from ቀጸበ), 'quarrelling' by sense (?); አርታዕክሙ 'you set right' (from ርትዐ 'be straight'; the causative). ዘተጋነይክሙ ሊተ: ተጋነየ is a verb of prayer in this text (ኢጸለዩ ኀቤሁ ወኢተጋነዩ ወኢሰአልዎ, ch. 6; ወሰአሉ ወተጋነዩ ወበፅዑ ለእግዚኣብሔር, ch. 62; Noah ተጋነየ ወሦዐ ወጸውዐ, ch. 9), so 'supplicate, entreat'; 'what you have entreated of me' (?). Echoes: Leviticus 26:11–12, Ezekiel 37:27, 2 Corinthians 6:16; ወኣንሶሱ is 'I will walk about' (ነሶሰወ, the published lemma; ወኣንሶሱ ማእከሎሙ again in ch. 106). The split አኀ ድር is printed so; I read it as አኀድር 'I will dwell' (1st singular imperfect of ኀደረ, spelled so in ch. 1 and 106), and also keep the printed spacing in the text.

sentences.t: ወትከውኑኒ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ ወእከውነክሙ ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ በጽድቅ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: and-you-shall-be-to-me my-people and-I-shall-be-to-you your-God in-righteousness. (nine ፨ marks)
sentences.i: And you will be my people, and I will be your God in righteousness.”
sentences.n: The promise of the covenant formula ('You shall be my people and I will be your God', Leviticus 26:12; Jeremiah 7:23; Ezekiel 37:27) closes God's address. ትከውኑኒ 'you will be to me' (ትከውኑ + -ኒ, 'to me'; the -ኒ here is the dative pronoun, not 'also'); እከውነክሙ 'I will be to you' (እከውን + -ክሙ); በጽድቅ 'in righteousness'. The nine ፨ marks printed at the end close the paragraph (the whole of this part is one paragraph); they stay on this last unit as in earlier parts.
